parameters: Wait! What if they're bad or... oh whatever...
Oho~ now there's some familiar faces. Looks like the darkness has led you to me.
O-Oh! It's you! You're the girl from our last field study! Uhm... Dine, right!?
You remember my name? Of course you do. I am the one who will eventually put an end to this place!
But looks like our meeting is a bit different this time, huh?
Considering you're cheerfullness, you definitely know what's going on here.
I wouldn't go around saying that... I'm kinda investigating but I'm also here to help any
lost people and guide them to the right place.
And you three are looking PRETTY lost right now.
Well I COULD but you're gonna have to help me first.
Dine steps aside and magically pops open a wagon filled with stuff.
Despite the circumstances, the merchant in me wants to sell the things I'm finding here. But I am also someone who can
help "teach" you things or even help your combat capabilities. Aren't I awesome?
You're seriously charging us in this situation?
A penny will always find it's pocket, as they say.
I mean you don't have to buy anything. I won't force you. But it may help you in the long run.
If you find me, I'll help out. So~ who wants to do some shopping?
I am NOT entertaining this right now.
We'll be seeing you, Darkness Girl Zero!
Oh, we will indeed be seeing each other again. Imma get that mira...
During future expeditions you'll see a shop node that allows you to spend mira you've obtained during the run
to buy your team a variety of things as well as sell unneeded items.
It ranges from Skills, Weapons, Accessories and upgrades as well. Additionally, Dine is able to remove cards from your deck
so if it's getting a bit packed be sure to spend some mira to lighten up that deck.
A dead end... but we could just go deep into the forest instead.
This might be rich coming from me but that sounds a bit risky don't you think?
What if we get lost and can't find our way back to our original location?
We honestly might not have any choice in this situation.
I say we do it. Better than sitting around being useless.
The party proceeds to step forward to go deeper into the forest.
.....!!! I sense something! Lila watch out!
I-Is that a giant robot like the one from the past?!
No, it's not the same type. They're more like standing knights but this is...
We can't exactly care what it is... we need to handle this! It's blocked our path back.
Alright! Stand back and let me handle it. I'm sure with my blade I can do damage to it.

parameters.name: Netsu/Crossing Over the Horrors of War

parameters: That takes care of that. Phew... I'm exhausted...
At least we made it out together! But... doesn't change the fact we're stranded...
Maybe we should have stayed with Dine. She's pretty strong.
But she doesn't even know what's going on, what good would it do us?
She's right. I think that we'll stumble upon something soon. We just need to close our eyes, pray and---
Oh my Aidios... it's a bird, it's a beast, it's the... THE...

parameters.name: Netsu/Crossing Over the Horrors of War

parameters: ///CG of the three of them looking surpsied.///
Boy... am I glad to see you... we've been searching for quite awhile.
Does that mean you know what's going on!?
I don't... have a clear picture just yet but we have someone aboard who does have an idea.
Do they really or you're just pulling our leg?
I have no reason... to joke around...
But rest assured... I am determined to help everyone out the best I can...
Oh my... such words from a leader!
Ha... I don't think you should refer to me as such...
That reminds me. We met a girl named Dine on the way here. I think we should help her.
No need... to worry about her. She'll be fine... besides we will need her help during our time here.
Now... come on... follow me... onto the ship...
Well... talk about a prayer. Good job, Cecilia.
Haha... I don't think it was really me though.
In any case, let's get a move on. Hopefully our friends are in there!
Welcome back to the Crimson Wings.
I'm honestly surprised...I managed to maintain it after the sudden teleportation...
You mean that sudden tremor we had earlier?
We were right over the basin if I'm correct...
It seems there was some sort of reaction when we flew over.
Yeah, I didn't see Liliana or anyone else from Class VII.
I'm not sure how to explain this but...
The trio turn around seeing someone walking through the doors.
I thought her name was Dawn.
Dawn, the showhost for Abend Time?
Both are correct, but Dawn is just fine.
As I'm sure you're all aware... Dawn is one of the Witches.
To refresh your minds: there are seven witches in total. Each one controls the elements of this world.
Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Time, Space and Mirage. I am in control of Mirage.
I am here today because you all have found yourselves trapped within a realm called the "Reverie".
The party looks puzzled at hearing this, something Dawn expected.
It's a place where possibilities are countless, endless and infinite all at the same time. A place where you can
see possibilities from yourselves in the most literal sense.
It's normally accessible through one of the witch's shrines but another way is through an artifact that
can directly transport people into it.
I've theorized that when you were traveling over the basin... the artifact activated transfering you all into the Reverie.
The bizarre thing however is that it scattered you all about. You three are the first Class VII members Miss Sara was able to find.
So everyone else is still missing...
However... we do plan to search for them. It's just that the Reverie is a bit hard to navigate... for several reasons.
The Reverie cultivates all occupants's possibilities or rather "memories" allowing people to experience them
together. However... you will run into memories that you don't remember happening.
That is because it grabs memories from alternate versions of yourselves. Created through different possibilities you
To make things a little more complicated... the Reverie changes it's appearance every visit which means even if you
successfully conquer a version of the Reverie, it will send you back until you've beaten the true possibility.
By traversing through it and reaching the anamoly that's affecting it. If I had to make a guess... this is the doing of the Witch of the End.
By finding her and defeating the various versions of her... you will find the correct possibility and get everyone out of here.
But first you'll need to find your classmates and any allies that can help.
This also means you'll have to encounter versions of others you know and of HIM as well.
As much as I'd love to help... I have to remain here to keep the ship stabilized to not get consumed by the Reverie so it
will be up to you, Class VII.
So... will you be able to take on this task?
I just want to find our classmates as our first priority.
From there we can make a proper plan... besides... none of us were fit to be the plan maker anyways.
Once we're all united, I'm sure we can properly pull through!
All for One and One for All... as they say!
I will do whatever I can to help and everyone else from Thors can help as well.. I did gather most of them so they will be helping
Operation: Reunite Class VII is a go!
Be careful. This is unexplored territory, so I don't want any Eustaces running all gung-ho.
I do sense a large series of prescences up ahead... we best be on our guards.
Nothing Class VII can't handle, right?
Besides, we have Ronnie on our side! Whatever is out there, we got this!
Eustace is right! Let's take care of these things, we'll figure out what they are later.
Teamed up with my most enthusiastic classmates... just my luck.
